raw_sections.summary:
Professional Summary
Certified Power Platform and RPA Developer with 5 years of experience building scalable automation and low-code solutions using Microsoft Power Platform (Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse) and Blue Prism. Strong exposure to enterprise integrations, cloud-based solutions, REST APIs, and regulated BFSI environments, with hands-on collaboration across business and technical stakeholders.
raw_sections.skills:
Technical Skills
Microsoft Power Platform: Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse, Azure AI Foundry • Programming & Development: C++, Java, SQL, Python • Cloud & Integration: Microsoft Azure (Logic Apps, Azure Functions), Microsoft Graph API, REST APIs, Postman • Databases: Dataverse, SQL Server, Firebase (NoSQL) • Agile & Collaboration: GitHub, Agile Methodologies, Stakeholder Engagement • Web Technologies: HTML, CSS, XML, JSON
raw_sections.certifications:
Certifications
Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Fundamentals (PL-900) • Microsoft Certified: Power Automate RPA Developer (PL-500) • Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) • Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900) • Blue Prism Certified Developer (AD01) • Blue Prism Certified Professional Developer (APD01) • Pursuing: Microsoft Certified – Power Platform Developer (PL-400)
raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
RPA Configurator | Blue Prism & Power Platform HSBC Electronic Data Processing Pvt. Ltd. – Hyderabad, Telangana July 2023 – Present • Developed and deployed automation solutions using Power Automate, Copilot Studio, and Blue Prism for banking operations. • Designed Power Apps and Power Automate flows to streamline workflows in a regulated BFSI environment. • Built integrations with backend systems using REST APIs and Azure Functions.
Collaborated with business users to gather functional requirements and translate them into scalable low-code applications. • Ensured compliance with data governance and regulatory standards. Engineer – Development | Blue Prism & Power Automate FIS Global – Pune, Maharashtra June 2021 – July 2023 • Developed RPA and workflow automation solutions using Blue Prism and Power Automate. • Migrated automations from UI-based execution to API-based integrations, improving reliability. • Documented solution design and technical specifications to support enterprise governance and compliance. • Worked with cross-functional teams to support application lifecycle management activities.
Android Developer FarmiGO Technologies – Pune, Maharashtra October 2020 – January 2021 • Developed Android applications and integrated third-party APIs. • Worked with REST services and backend systems for mobile application workflows.
Android Developer Khairnar Technologies – Pune, Maharashtra December 2019 – May 2020 • Integrated payment and video streaming APIs within Android applications. • Enhanced application functionality through backend service consumption.
